main_text.l: Cooperante Domino. Id est, Domino intrinsecus aperiente
hominum corda, ut intenderent his, quæ ab Apostolis
habet in cælo, qui corda docet.
demonstrantibus, ut patet ex Actis Apostolorum.

l.i: Semper agam grates Christo, dabo semper honores,Laus Domini semper vivet in ore meo.

page.notes: The rules above and below FINIS are printed ornamental lines, not text. The verse at the foot is set in bold italic. No catchword, signature or other furniture is visible.
